_design: Nightly gardener. TRIGGER is a node-side cron entry (03:00) running scripts/garden-run.sh — NOT n8n, because Cilium blocks the n8n pod from reaching the node over SSH (pod->host). The script does: reset a dedicated checkout, exo index, exo garden, claude -p (apply edits, no API key), exo index, commit, push, then POST a run summary to this n8n webhook. This workflow is the RECEIVER, for visibility/history in n8n. Live workflow id: C2El9oMIVyYDbZsr.
name: exocortex · gardener report
